name: Namida ~Ryuusei no Saddle~
source:
Aizaki Shinobi is hero's first love. Her mood has dropped as of late and she started to avoid hero. He needs to get to know what's happening to his dear friend.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-november-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
相崎忍是主人公的初恋。近来她情绪低落，开始躲避主人公。他必须弄清挚友究竟发生了什么。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-november-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
